description: Main entry script for the openclaw package that sets up environment, version checks, conditional imports, and handles command line arguments to provide help or launch main functionalities.

methods.name: parseNodeVersion
methods.description: Parses a raw version string into major and minor numbers.

methods.name: isSupportedNodeVersion
methods.description: Checks if a given node version meets the minimum required version.

methods.name: ensureSupportedNodeVersion
methods.description: Ensures the running Node.js version is supported or exits.

methods.name: isModuleNotFoundError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a Node.js module not found error.

methods.name: isDirectModuleNotFoundError
methods.description: Checks if an error corresponds to a specific module not found scenario.

methods.name: installProcessWarningFilter
methods.description: Attempts to import and install a process warning filter from specific modules.

methods.name: tryImport
methods.description: Tries to dynamically import a module and handles not found errors.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a specified URL (file path) exists.

methods.name: buildMissingEntryErrorMessage
methods.description: Constructs an error message indicating missing build output.

methods.name: isBareRootHelpInvocation
methods.description: Detects if the CLI was invoked with help flags.

methods.name: loadPrecomputedRootHelpText
methods.description: Loads precomputed root help text from a JSON file if available.

methods.name: tryOutputBareRootHelp
methods.description: Attempts to output root help text when invoked with help flags.
